ModifyElasticityAssurance.elasticityAssuranceIds: Elasticity assurance IDs, up to 100 per request
ModifyElasticityAssurance.autoRenew: Whether to enable auto-renewal. true: enable or modify auto-renewal; false: cancel auto-renewal
ModifyElasticityAssurance.autoRenewPeriod: Auto-renewal period. Required when autoRenew=true, in months; allowed values: 1-9, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60. Not required when autoRenew=false, and ignored if provided
